verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair axis for an ecommerce platform, but the evidence pack shows no first-party automation, workflow, or scheduled-task feature that runs autonomously. Webhooks, REST/GraphQL APIs, and the app marketplace are developer building blocks a user could wire into external automations, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
